The report page is a preview, not the full report. GET /reports/:id in src/api/reports.ts loads at most PREVIEW_ROWS = 50 transactions through transactionRepo.listForReport, and the CSV/XLSX export is the path that covers the whole date range. So the 6,400-row export is expected, and the page is meant to show only 50 rows. I did not read transactionRepo.listForReport in this run, so I cannot confirm from the code why the 50 preview rows are early January rows rather than the newest ones. For the full data, use the export. A maintainer should check the ordering of the preview query separately.
